description: This file defines an interface 'EndpointResult' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2' namespace. It declares methods for normalizing an object to an array and retrieving metadata and relationships, serving as a contract for endpoint result representations in the API module of the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an associative array representation of the object.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns a ParameterBag object containing metadata, or null if not available.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Returns a ParameterBag object containing relationships, or null if not available.
